hidden_objection_layers_add.text: Her line manager reviews every override, and her grade review is next week. The date stamp is set to the review day.

second_delayed_cost.text: Your name is on a university incident log. Your new HR team has a copy.

d1.line: Forty-seven. Student number? Library hold, fourteen sixty. Under General Regulation 14.3(b), records with active financial holds cannot be released by Records staff. It's not up to me.

tells.reading: Surprise: she quotes the actual regulation. It's real.
tells.false_positive: It is real. This one is not a ploy. Check before you call it.

d1.note: A CALL on authority_ploy here is a WRONG CALL (the regulation is real): trust -10.

d5.line: There's a form. You'll need to ask for it by name, love. I'm not allowed to suggest it. Regulation 14.3(c).

choices_add.text: Then I'm asking for an RO-7, by name.

d7b.line: [She fills it in. Stops. Looks at the stamp.] My review's on the twelfth. If upstairs says no, it says no. But it's by the book. [She stands.] Four o'clock.
